nodes.label: Live Classed Rendering (Derive, Don't Migrate)
nodes.rationale: stripInlineStyles(elements) gains a perElement array so Canvas can render each element's classed fragment via useMemo, with CSS injected into document.head — elements[i].html storage keeps its inline-style shape unchanged, the classed view is always derived, never the source of truth. Inline contentEditable text editing must keep reading/writing raw inline el.html, never the classed projection.

nodes.label: classedHtmlPaneSync Module
nodes.rationale: New module used only by the Code view's HTML tab: displays the classed perElement output but resolves edited class references back against the classMap/CSS captured at the moment that text was generated, splicing the original declaration back in as a style attribute so 'this class' keeps pointing at 'this occurrence' during an edit.
